marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind southwest 10 to 15 knots backing to south 20 after midnight
then increasing to southwest 30 to 40 late overnight. Wind diminishing to
southwest 20 Thursday afternoon. Risk of freezing rain Thursday
afternoon. Low tonight minus 4. High Thursday plus 2. <br/>
